theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Gold Clinches Weekly Gain on Growing Bullish ETF, Energy Signs
top_news.summary: Gold advanced, notching a weekly gain amid rising demand for bullion-backed exchange traded funds and signs that inflation may ease.

top_news.title: Atomic Machines CEO on Developing 'Micro-Machines'
top_news.summary: Atomic Machines CEO Jeffrey Holden discusses a new kind of factory that takes digital code and produces 'micro-machines.' He says the technology is being developed to support a broader range of 'micro-machines.' He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bambusa Therapeutics Files for IPO to Fund Eczema Drug Trials
top_news.summary: Bambusa Therapeutics Inc. filed for a initial public offering to help fund trials of its drugs to treat eczema and other inflammation disorders.

top_news.title: Wall Street Rallies Ahead of Next Week's Earnings | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Sally Bakewell, Carol Massar and Jess Menton. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Cable One Blocked From Mega Broadband Deal for Now by Judge
top_news.summary: Cable One Inc. was temporarily blocked by a federal judge from acquiring a 55% equity stake in Mega Broadband Investments from private equity firm GTCR, after lender CoBank ACB sued to stop the deal.

top_news.title: SpaceX’s Wireless Threat Rises With Spectrum Deal
top_news.summary: SpaceX investors are finally getting some reprieve after months of being whipsawed by volatility as the Elon Musk-led company’s stock breaks above the level it’s been stuck below since July. SpaceX is closing in on a crucial swath of spectrum needed to turn the rocket, satellite and AI company into a “major mobile carrier,” setting the stage for a clash with stalwarts like T-Mobile US Inc., Verizon Communications Inc. and AT&T Inc. top_news.title: Surveillance Pricing, Orszag's Retirement Warning, Suburb Discount Dwindles
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Lazard CEO & Chairman Peter Orszag and Partners Group Chief Investment Strategist Anastasia Amoroso. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Dollar Notches Its Longest Winning Streak Since Early 2025
top_news.summary: The dollar rally is forging ahead as soaring oil prices weigh on currencies of energy importing nations and global inflation fears persist.

top_news.title: A Big Asset Manager Deleveraging Is Underway in Treasury Futures
top_news.summary: Asset managers are offloading long-duration Treasuries futures contracts, an indication that forced selling is underway as cash yields hover just off multiyear highs.

top_news.title: Social Security Has To Be Addressed: Orszag
top_news.summary:
"Both social security and Medicare have looming problems." That's Lazard's Peter Orszag on "Bloomberg Money" discussing how nothing will change for those programs without a crisis.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
